result.summary: Diagnosed GH-501 / ISS-0173 root cause empirically. src/oidc/jwks.zig is ORPHANED on three independent axes (no addTest root, no build.zig named module, main.zig:78 dead re-export with zero callers), so zig build is GREEN while the file contains 5 hard Zig 0.16 compile errors. Empirical proof via `zig test src/oidc/jwks.zig` exits 1 with: (1) jwks.zig:322 std.Thread.Mutex removed in 0.16 -- not a rename-only fix; std.Io.Mutex requires Io parameter at every lock/unlock. (2-3) jwks.zig:140, 239 std.ArrayList(T).init does not exist -- Zig 0.16 returns the unmanaged form. (4) jwks.zig:248 unmanaged deinit now takes allocator (also jwks.zig:247, 148, 172). (5) jwks.zig:265 unmanaged append now takes allocator (also jwks.zig:144, 168, 194). 10 findings total: 5 BLOCKER (MUST-1..5), 3 MAJOR (MUST-6 in-file tests unreachable; MUST-7 mutex path unexercised; MUST-8 main.zig:78 dead re-export), 2 MINOR (SHOULD-1 filename/content mismatch; SHOULD-2 linter does not detect dead re-exports). Fix path defined for CODE-DESIGNER: wire file into real test target first, then mechanical ArrayList migration, then non-mechanical mutex refactor to std.Io.Mutex, then decide orphan fate (delete vs rename vs rewire caller), then deliberate-mutation regression, then census run for same pattern.
